title: TERRIBLE! Fell apart when I put it together and was unusable!
text: TERRIBLE! Fell apart when I put it together and was unusable!. I screwed the handle on and the bottom part just fell part!! This thing is cheap junk! I got a replacement plunger and got it together without breaking but then it didn't work with either of our toilets, this thing is just garbage! I wouldn't pay $1 for this!
